role: The server's per-player stat store, persisted to stats/<uuid>.json, with the dirty set and the paced S37 send (every 300 ticks, or at once on a new achievement) and the login send of unlocked achievements.
scope_reason: The S37 packets it sends are part of the recorded stream and drive the client toast.

members.name: func_150876_a
members.note: the whole dirty set (achievements, general and per-item stats) through the surv_s37 ring. The 300-tick clock is getTickCounter, which stands still while the integrated server is paused (the credits screen): server_player.paused_ticks counts those rows (session.c session_row) and surv_add_stat flushes on server_tick - paused_ticks.

notes: The S37 map order differs from Java's HashMap order; survival.c argues the client applies all entries before any toast logic so order does not change state. Not verified that the oracle's S37 row format compares entry sets rather than sequences.
